levels.surface: أبو عامر عبد الملك بن عمرو

notes: «وسمى الرجل حميد بن عبد الرحمن» sits between dashes: an editor gloss, left out; if it names the unnamed man of the second route, the link would be «حميد بن عبد الرحمن» (rule 8): decide
«و سمى» is not a route; «هو في نفسي أفضل» is Muslim's remark with no name
«بإسناد يحيى بن سعيد» is a back_reference to Yahya's chain, which the text does not repeat
the second isnad after «ح» carries the same saying: its own group, not variant
